title: PCPP description
statement: Let $n\ge1$ and let $P$ be a property of Boolean words of length $n$. A PCPP description of $P$ specifies a proof length, a query count, a finite PCPP system with Boolean alphabet and those parameters, and a real rejection rate such that the system has the PCPP property for $P$ at that rate.
hypotheses_covered: P is a property of Boolean words of length n
A PCPP system over the Boolean alphabet with input length n and the specified proof length and query count
The system satisfies IsPCPP for P at that rejection rate
